chronology.claim_label: retrospective excluded-source test of a pre-existing representation

prediction_basis.finance_target: Quality-controlled selection that preserves complexity and diversity should improve finance-domain utility over unselected or one-coordinate alternatives.
prediction_basis.general_retention: Finance continual pre-training without an explicit retention mechanism creates a general-capability risk relative to the starting model.
prediction_basis.model_transfer: The directions should transfer across the two backbones because they describe candidate-target contracts rather than model identity.

scoring.primary: directional accuracy on candidate-target comparisons specified by the pre-existing representation
scoring.best_candidate: CDF-GC for finance and the starting model for general retention
scoring.independence_guardrail: The four model-target panels remain one source-level test.
